newsitem.title: USA: US stocks jump, S&P hits new high.
newsitem.headline: US stocks jump, S&P hits new high.

text.p: The Dow industrials snapped a three-day losing streak and the S&P 500 snared a record close Friday as triple-witching lent an upward bias to stocks.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 20.72 points higher at 5,888.46, below Monday's record finish of 5,889.20.
The Standard & Poor's index of 500 stocks rose 4.02 to 687.02, above Monday's record close of 683.98.
The Nasdaq composite index was up 7.56 points at 1,219.65, nearing its record close of 1,249.15 set on June 5.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances 14-8 on active volume of 515 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
